body:
Good morning, my friend!

Today is Sunday, the day of rest. God rested on the seventh day, and He gives us days to rest, too.

There is no work to do today. The chapel bells are ringing, and the neighbors are gathering there. You might visit the chapel, read a book, or sit by the river and listen. I hope it is a happy, quiet day.
summary: Sunday: a day of rest. No work today.
